title: Hyperframes Genie

beats.headline: Plan the film in types
beats.body: A model returns scenes, copy, and color. Nothing else.

beats.headline: HTML is the timeline
beats.body: Each scene is a paused composition the renderer can seek.

beats.headline: Then it becomes video
beats.body: Check the composition, preview it, and render the mp4.
